figurative_meaning_bn: একদিনে তিন তিথির যোগ; অশুভ যোগ
figurative_meaning_en: Conjunction of three lunar days in one solar day; an inauspicious alignment
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ ত্রয়হস্পর্শের যোগ আছে, কোনো শুভ কাজ করা উচিত নয়।
ত্রয়হস্পর্শের দিনে বিয়ে ঠিক করলে অশুভ ফল হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Today is a tryahsparsha day, so no auspicious activities should be planned.
Fixing a wedding on a tryahsparsha is considered to bring bad luck.
history: This idiom originates from the Hindu lunar calendar (panchang), where tithis are lunar days; tryahsparsha refers to an overlap of three tithis in one solar day, considered inauspicious in traditional Bengali Hindu practices.
